questions.question: 10 women can complete a work in 7 days and 10 children take 14 days to complete the same work. How many days will 5 women and 10 children take to complete the work?
questions.solution: Solution: Given: 10 women can complete a work in 7 days and 10 children take 14 days to complete the same work. Calculation: One woman will complete the task in 10 × 7 = 70 days. Therefore, 5 women will complete the task in (70 / 5)=14  days. Hence, 5 women's 1 day-work is = 1/14 part  And 10 children's 1 day-work is = 1/14 part So, 5 women's and 10 children's 1 day-work = 1/14 + 1/14 ⇒ 2/14 = 1/7 Therefore, 5 women and 10 children can complete the work
